info.title: penplot web workbench API
info.description: 写字机 / 笔式绘图仪工作台 API。认证：Cookie 会话（不安全方法需加 `X-Penplot: 1`）或 `Authorization: Bearer ppt_<id>_<secret>`。错误体：`{"error":{"code","message","detail"}}`。

post.description: Change your own password (any role); revokes your other sessions.

get.description: Everyone may see the user list (for presence); only admins change it.

post.description: Admin password reset; revokes all of that user's sessions.

schema.title: Response List Fonts Api V1 Fonts Get

get.description: `from` is an index into the font's sorted codepoint list; with `text` only those chars.

put.description:
Other viewers of the project get WS `project` {kind:'doc', rev, by}. Send `X-Conn-Id`
(your WS conn_id) so your own client can ignore the echo.

patch.description:
409 element_locked if another user holds a soft lock on it (force=1 overrides).
Broadcasts WS `project` {kind:'element', patch} to the other viewers.

get.description:
Binary polylines, little endian: u32 magic 'PPL1', u32 n, u32 offsets[n+1]
(point index), f32 xy[2*offsets[n]]. Page space: mm, y down.

schema.title: Response Save Render Api V1 Render  Rid  Save Post
Response List Tasks Api V1 Tasks Get

post.description:
Reference background for Page.background (never printed): PNG/JPEG/WebP (EXIF rotation baked
in, longest side <= 3000 px) or a PDF (page `page` rasterised at `dpi`; the PDF is kept as
`source` so other pages can be picked).
Rasterise another page of an uploaded background PDF.

get.description: Small preview of one page of a background PDF (page picker).

schema.title: Response List Files Api V1 Files Get
Response List Jobs Api V1 Jobs Get

post.description: Take machine control. 409 lease_held if someone else has it (admins may force).

schema.title: Response Presence Api V1 Presence Get
Response Ports Api V1 Machine Ports Get

post.description:
Release a feed hold that no job owns (machine pause button, hold kept over a
reconnect): soft reset, buffered moves are discarded, position kept after Hold:0.
E-stop: every signed-in user (viewers too), never rate limited, never lease-gated.

schema.title: Response Grbl Settings Api V1 Machine Grbl Settings Get
Response Put Grbl Settings Api V1 Machine Grbl Settings Put
Response List Profiles Api V1 Profiles Get

post.description:
multipart `files` (one or more): a penplot profile export / MachineConfig json, or the original
software's settings.json + Grbl.json / Marlin.json / EBB.json / KAT.json (+ AdvancedViewData.json,
AxesData.json), or a zip of those. Form `type` (Grbl/Marlin/Ebb/K_AT) overrides detection.

schema.title: Response Logs Api V1 System Logs Get
Response Audit Api V1 System Audit Get

post.description:
Self-test with remediation hints: serial, banner, $$ vs profile, status latency,
optional pen up/down test (needs confirm + the control lease), WiFi, disk, memory, temp,
fonts, clock, data dir.

get.description:
What happened (crash, unplug, alarm, lost origin, failed job) and the steps to get going again;
each step may carry the API call that performs it.

Exists only so the WS message models appear in openapi components.
Connect to `GET /api/v1/ws` (WebSocket) instead.
The monospace stroke font (grid units: x 0..4, y down 0 cap .. 6 baseline .. 8 descender).

post.description:
Lay out sample text on the teletype grid with the given settings (unset fields: the session's,
else defaults): geometry, char cells (CJK = 2) and glyph paths exactly as the pen would draw them.
The font is loaded once off the event loop and cached.

Start a paper-terminal session: holds the machine like a job (no jobs meanwhile; e-stop works).
The current pen position becomes the paper's top-left corner (set_zero, default true).

delete.description: End the session: unsent text is dropped, pen up, back to the origin.

post.description:
Typing mode: each char is written at once with the session font; CJK / full-width chars take two
cells; full-width punctuation becomes ASCII only when no font has it. In terminal mode the text goes
to the shell instead.
Confirm a fresh sheet is in place: new page, buffered output continues.

OriginSpec.title: OriginSpec
OriginSpec.description:
Where the machine origin (pen position at job start) sits on the page.

corner: 0 LeftUp, 1 RightUp, 2 LeftDown, 3 RightDown (AxesSettings.pos).
offset_x_mm / offset_y_mm: distance of the origin from that corner,
measured inward along the page edges (page mm); with anchor='content'
the corner is that of the drawing's bounding box instead of the paper.
revxy / x_rev / y_rev: machine axis mapping (AxesSettings).
rotation: page rotation onto the machine (0/90/180/270).
set_zero_at_start: None = profile default (settings.autoSetZero).
